fallback.soilDescription: Sloped colluvial foothill deposits outside the core valley floor polygons.
fallback.engineeringRecommendation: Contour Recharge Trench (1.5m depth) with silt trap to prevent hillside runoff.

properties.soilDescription: Coarse sand and gravel alluvial deposits (Budhanilkantha, Tokha, Bansbari, Gokarna) with high vertical permeability.
properties.engineeringRecommendation: Deep Percolation Pit (2.5m–3.5m depth) with boulder-gravel-sand filter media for direct deep aquifer replenishment.

properties.soilDescription: Thick impermeable lacustrine black clay (Kalimati formation) across core KMC, Putalisadak, Tripureshwor, and Patan limiting deep percolation.
properties.engineeringRecommendation: Shallow Dug-Well / Gravel Retention Trench (1.2m–1.8m depth) to detain storm peak runoff and recharge perched shallow aquifers.

properties.soilDescription: Interbedded gravel, silt, and clay deposits (Harisiddhi, Chapagaun, Godawari, Kirtipur south) with moderate infiltration capacity.
properties.engineeringRecommendation: Standard Modular Recharge Pit (2.0m–2.5m depth) paired with permeable courtyard paving.
